name: Watch attribute hierarchy final
command:
while :; do curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8321/api/jobs/1 > /tmp/job1.json || exit 2; s=$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("/tmp/job1.json"))["state"])'); case "$s" in done|failed|cancelled) echo "job1 $s"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
j=json.load(open('/tmp/job1.json'));print('\n'.join(j.get('log',[])[-3:]));print(j.get('error'))
PY
exit 0;; esac; sleep 20; done
